units.rawText: So this is what the area around the venue looks like... Quite the lively place.

units.rawText: Being lively is just part of it. I looked it up before I came; while this district is famous for its arts and entertainment industry, it's got a long, checkered history to it.

units.rawText: Hm? I see. The old man and I don't really know this stuff, being secluded in the mountains and all.

units.displayText: Oh? Such as?

units.rawText: For instance... Your master, as one of my clients. There are hardly any pictures of him available.
units.displayText: For instance... Your master, as one of my clients. There are hardly any pictures of him available.

units.rawText: Oh yeah, that's right! The old man hates having his picture taken; he's really strict about it.

spans.text: Oh yeah, that's right! The old man hates having his picture taken; he's really strict about it.

units.rawText: If you had a picture to consult, you wouldn't be so confused when you just met him, right?
units.displayText: If you had a picture to consult, you wouldn't be so confused when you just met him, right?

spans.text: If you had a picture to consult, you wouldn't be so confused when you just met him, right?

units.rawText: Indeed, there's just too little information available about him. For a moment, I even wondered if you were the master's heir...

units.rawText: Hahahaha, I doubt that. Ultimately, we're just master and servant.
units.displayText: Hahahaha, I doubt that. Ultimately, we're just master and servant.

spans.text: Hahahaha, I doubt that. Ultimately, we're just master and servant.

units.rawText: The old man has a kid of his own... though they don't live together.
units.displayText: The old man has a kid of his own... though they don't live together.

spans.text: The old man has a kid of his own... though they don't live together.

units.rawText: I was actually a little sad to hear that at first. Looks like I'm just a spoilt brat after all.
units.displayText: I was actually a little sad to hear that at first. Looks like I'm just a spoilt brat after all.

units.rawText: Do you really think so?
units.displayText: Do you really think so?

spans.text: Do you really think so?

units.rawText: Hm? You mean you see it differently?
units.displayText: Hm? You mean you see it differently?

spans.text: Hm? You mean you see it differently?

units.rawText: While I've never seen the Master before, it doesn't seem like he treats you as a servant.
units.displayText: While I've never seen the Master before, it doesn't seem like he treats you as a servant.

spans.text: While I've never seen the Master before, it doesn't seem like he treats you as a servant.

units.rawText: Of course I know that, I'm not dumb. The way the old man treats me isn't simple generosity.
units.displayText: Of course I know that, I'm not dumb. The way the old man treats me isn't simple generosity.

spans.text: Of course I know that, I'm not dumb. The way the old man treats me isn't simple generosity.

units.rawText: Some people in the household address me as "Young Master" too. I couldn't really get used to that at first.

units.rawText: That's not all. I took a look at the order and angle at which the shoes were arranged when I entered the estate. From that—
units.displayText: That's not all. I took a look at the order and angle at which the shoes were arranged when I entered the estate. From that—

spans.text: That's not all. I took a look at the order and angle at which the shoes were arranged when I entered the estate. From that—

units.rawText: There are times when you enter the house ahead of the "old master", am I wrong? That would be almost unthinkable for the masters of most Dolls.
units.displayText: There are times when you enter the house ahead of the "old master", am I wrong? That would be almost unthinkable for the masters of most Dolls.

spans.text: There are times when you enter the house ahead of the "old master", am I wrong? That would be almost unthinkable for the masters of most Dolls.

units.rawText: Hahaha, I can't believe you noticed all that. You really are a great detective!
units.displayText: Hahaha, I can't believe you noticed all that. You really are a great detective!

spans.text: Hahaha, I can't believe you noticed all that. You really are a great detective!

units.rawText: But what if I told you the old man wasn't the sort to put on airs?
units.displayText: But what if I told you the old man wasn't the sort to put on airs?

spans.text: But what if I told you the old man wasn't the sort to put on airs?

units.rawText: If he truly acted that way, then the other security Dolls and visitors would not be so formal and polite around him.
units.displayText: If he truly acted that way, then the other security Dolls and visitors would not be so formal and polite around him.

spans.text: If he truly acted that way, then the other security Dolls and visitors would not be so formal and polite around him.

units.rawText: Also, when we were talking in the drawing room, you mentioned the master of the house was resting in his room, but I noticed the cane leaning against the rack by the doorway.
units.displayText: Also, when we were talking in the drawing room, you mentioned the master of the house was resting in his room, but I noticed the cane leaning against the rack by the doorway.

spans.text: Also, when we were talking in the drawing room, you mentioned the master of the house was resting in his room, but I noticed the cane leaning against the rack by the doorway.

units.rawText: It was finely-made, but didn't seem to provide much in the way of stability. To my knowledge, that's not the sort of cane a senior citizen would use to help them walk.
units.displayText: It was finely-made, but didn't seem to provide much in the way of stability. To my knowledge, that's not the sort of cane a senior citizen would use to help them walk.

spans.text: It was finely-made, but didn't seem to provide much in the way of stability. To my knowledge, that's not the sort of cane a senior citizen would use to help them walk.

units.rawText: In traditional culture, such canes are a symbol of power and authority, not ease of movement.
units.displayText: In traditional culture, such canes are a symbol of power and authority, not ease of movement.

spans.text: In traditional culture, such canes are a symbol of power and authority, not ease of movement.

units.rawText: You DO have a keen eye! Yeah, the old man's fit as a fiddle, but this is the first time I've seen someone who could tell that from his cane alone.
units.displayText: You DO have a keen eye! Yeah, the old man's fit as a fiddle, but this is the first time I've seen someone who could tell that from his cane alone.

spans.text: You DO have a keen eye! Yeah, the old man's fit as a fiddle, but this is the first time I've seen someone who could tell that from his cane alone.

units.rawText: That cane showed signs of use, and it was clearly not something kept in a storage case to be taken out for special occasions.
units.displayText: That cane showed signs of use, and it was clearly not something kept in a storage case to be taken out for special occasions.

spans.text: That cane showed signs of use, and it was clearly not something kept in a storage case to be taken out for special occasions.

units.rawText: Senior citizens who use such canes usually place great emphasis on their social position.
units.displayText: Senior citizens who use such canes usually place great emphasis on their social position.

spans.text: Senior citizens who use such canes usually place great emphasis on their social position.

units.rawText: For a master like that, anyone that he would allow to walk by his side or ahead of him would either be very much in his favor... or someone he dotes upon deeply.

units.displayText: ...Dotes upon?

units.displayText: Wait, you mean like, I'm a dog or something?

units.rawText: But to me, the master of the house treats you like a child who grew up in the household.
units.displayText: But to me, the master of the house treats you like a child who grew up in the household.

spans.text: But to me, the master of the house treats you like a child who grew up in the household.

units.rawText: I was designed with terrain scanning and clue logging technologies that could be used in tandem with daily activities.

spans.text: I was designed with terrain scanning and clue logging technologies that could be used in tandem with daily activities.

units.rawText: Being able to multitask the use of my recording, analysis and cogitation modules, alongside linguistic processing modules is a basic requirement of the job.

units.rawText: Damn, that's really something else... I have to say, that's some impressive processing power you've got there.

units.rawText: So, given your professional skills, is there really a case you can't crack? The only thing standing in your way is just a lack of information, right?

units.displayText: That's—!

units.displayText: Quit standing around, Dupin! Get them!
